# Skill usage feedback

- Scenario: task mode, language/framework, relevant project setup.
- Expected behavior: observable outcome or constraint.
- Actual behavior: what happened and its impact.
- Evidence: minimal commands, diff, test result, or trace excerpt; sanitize before sharing.

Optional investigation context:

- Skill revision / model / agent version: use unknown if unavailable.
- Reproduction: reproducible / intermittent / not yet attempted.
- Suspected cause: project configuration / scanner / instruction / adapter / core rule / unknown.
- Regression case ID: assign when a case is created.
- Next step: observation only / reproduce / proposed fix / validated fix.

This record captures an observation; it is not a claim that a proposed fix has been evaluated.
